name: Vanilla
script_install:
#!/bin/ash
# Vanilla Minecraft installation script
set -eu

MANIFEST_URL="https://launchermeta.mojang.com/mc/game/version_manifest.json"
cd /mnt/server

SERVER_JARFILE="${SERVER_JARFILE:-server.jar}"
MINECRAFT_VERSION="${MINECRAFT_VERSION:-latest}"

download_jar() {
    url="$1"
    target="$2"
    echo "[Atlas] Downloading ${url}"
    rm -f "${target}.part"
    if ! curl -fSL --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 -o "${target}.part" "${url}"; then
        echo "[Atlas] Error: the download failed." >&2
        rm -f "${target}.part"
        exit 1
    fi
    if [ "$(head -c 2 "${target}.part")" != "PK" ]; then
        echo "[Atlas] Error: the downloaded file is not a valid jar." >&2
        rm -f "${target}.part"
        exit 1
    fi
    mv -f "${target}.part" "${target}"
}

echo "[Atlas] Looking up Minecraft versions"
MANIFEST=$(curl -fsSL --retry 3 "${MANIFEST_URL}")

if [ "${MINECRAFT_VERSION}" = "latest" ]; then
    VERSION=$(echo "${MANIFEST}" | jq -r '.latest.release')
else
    VERSION="${MINECRAFT_VERSION}"
fi

VERSION_URL=$(echo "${MANIFEST}" | jq -r --arg v "${VERSION}" '.versions[] | select(.id == $v) | .url')
if [ -z "${VERSION_URL}" ]; then
    echo "[Atlas] Error: Minecraft has no version ${VERSION}." >&2
    exit 1
fi

echo "[Atlas] Installing Minecraft ${VERSION}"
DOWNLOAD_URL=$(curl -fsSL --retry 3 "${VERSION_URL}" | jq -r '.downloads.server.url')
if [ -z "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" ] || [ "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" = "null" ]; then
    echo "[Atlas] Error: Minecraft ${VERSION} has no server download." >&2
    exit 1
fi

download_jar "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" "${SERVER_JARFILE}"

echo "eula=true" > eula.txt
echo "[Atlas] Finalizing installation"

variables.name: Minecraft Version
variables.description: Minecraft version to install (for example 1.21.11), or 'latest'. Current versions need Java 25; pick an older Java image for older versions.
